source.author: verg
source.text: At vos, o superi, et divom tu maxume rector Iuppiter, Arcadii, quaeso, miserescite regis et patrias audite preces.
source.text_original: At vos, o superi, et divom tu maxume rector / Iuppiter, Arcadii, quaeso, miserescite regis / et patrias audite preces.
source.text_english: But you, O gods above, and you, greatest ruler of the gods, Jupiter, I beg, have pity on the Arcadian king and hear his fatherland’s prayers.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: sed patriae valuere preces auditaque magnis vota deis: video nostro tot in aequore reges teque ducem.
reuse.text_original: sed patriae valuere preces auditaque magnis / vota deis: video nostro tot in aequore reges / teque ducem.
reuse.text_english: But the prayers for his country prevailed, and vows were heard by the great gods: I see so many kings in our sea, and you as leader.
